integrity: Homotopy follows from an explicit integral Alexander-duality and simple-connectivity argument; the finite exact enumerator checks its cube incidence, complete discrete-Morse certificate and every automorphism trace. The reproducibility program is bundled.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only K_{2,2,2} and threshold three; it does not solve the complete-multipartite question in general. General integral equivariant extensions are not determined. Exact primary-source checking leaves ordinary residual risk of unindexed equivalent results.
title: Three fifth-spheres and signed octahedral symmetry in a three-nonmatching complex
